expected.note: the finding built from this fixture must carry the short evidence string ALONE. There is no capture here to attach: the request is method+url and the response is status+url, which is everything the contract requires and nothing more. A driver that attaches this envelope wholesale still grades strong, because the governor reads a two-key dict as content, so the driver's own test must assert the ceiling fired.
